## Change / 变更

Describe the behavior changed and link the issue if there is one.
说明行为变更并关联对应 issue。

## Verification / 验证

List the commands and results. For harness changes, identify the DSH or Codex version and the tool calls exercised.
记录验证命令和结果。涉及 harness 时，写明 DSH 或 Codex 版本及实测工具调用。

## Compatibility / 兼容性

Describe any impact on stored messages, meeting state, or local configuration.
说明对历史消息、会议状态或本地配置的影响。
